formal.title: A conformal-priced dual variable certifies the overtake/yield passing-side switches of a continuous full-function planner as the breakpoints of a (time, certified-risk) Pareto staircase
formal.model_setup:
Per-episode static snapshot. Horizon [0,H] (H~2-3s); only the trusted window [0,τ] with τ=tau_trust=0.75s is enforced (local_opt_hardalm trust mask), commit<τ, receding re-cert. m relevant detected+classified agents with frozen predictions x̂_i:[0,H]→ℝ², i∈[m]; Hum⊆[m] = latched "human" label-set agents (硬约束). r_body = body radius.

CONFORMAL RISK (branch ① only). Per-agent time-shaped score s_i=max_t‖e_i(t)‖/ρ_i(t); within agent i's Mondrian (class×density) cell the (1−α)-conformal radius is r_i(α)=q̂_i(1−α)·sup_t ρ_i(t), with r_i:(0,1)→ℝ_{>0} continuous & strictly decreasing (smaller miscoverage ⇒ larger tube). Tube T_i(α)={(p,t):‖p−x̂_i(t)‖≤r_i(α)+r_body}.

DECISION & QUANTITIES. A route ξ is a path in a risk-weighted (station,time)×lane RCSP DAG G=(V,E): V={(s,ℓ,t)} (s=arc-station on the fixed A* guide, ℓ=lateral lane, t=time level), edges station- and time-monotone under v/a limits (the existing st_graph.hpp DP {sample_stations, build_blocked, solve_st_graph}, NS=12, NT=48, augmented with lateral lanes ℓ and a risk resource — new). ξ realizes a continuous quintic τ_ξ via MINCO flat coords (q,T) (minjerk_traj.hpp). Define:
 • Clearance gap_i(ξ)=min_{t∈[0,min(H,τ)]}‖τ_ξ(t)−x̂_i(t)‖−r_body, soundly lower-bounded in continuous time by the Bernstein control-point hull (minjerk_traj.hpp control_points()/C2B_matrix() — the S3 certificate).
 • Per-agent certified risk ρ_i(ξ)=clip(r_i^{-1}(gap_i(ξ)),[0,ᾱ_i]); for i∈Hum, ρ_i≤α_i^hard is a HARD constraint (route infeasible, C=+∞, if gap_i<r_i(α_i^hard)). Aggregate R(ξ)=Σ_i ρ_i(ξ); the inner allocation α_i:=ρ_i(ξ) realizes Σα_i≤ε reallocation.
 • Cost C(ξ)≥0 = makespan/effort = w_time·((T_tot−T_target)/T_target)² + w_smooth·J_jerk(ξ) + v/a hinges (exactly minco_cost_grad.hpp; additive, λ-independent).
 • Winding signature h(ξ)=(σ_1,…,σ_m)∈{+1,−1}^m, σ_i=sign of the net signed angle swept by δ_i(t)=τ_ξ,xy(t)−x̂_{i,xy}(t) about 0 (homotopy class in π_1(ℝ²∖{0}) reduced to its sign for one encounter); +1=ahead/抢/overtake, −1=behind/让/yield. (Today only discrete representatives exist: passing_side single H-sig + generate_detour_seeds ≤5 ±u/±v; the class quotient is new.)

LAGRANGIAN. L(ξ,λ)=C(ξ)+λ(R(ξ)−ε), λ≥0; ε=ε_cls+ε_pred (=0.1, split 0.02+0.08). Finite candidate set Ξ (all DAG routes / seeds). Value g(λ)=min_{ξ∈Ξ}L(ξ,λ); class value g_h(λ)=min_{ξ∈Ξ:h(ξ)=h}L(ξ,λ); active class h*(λ)=argmin_h g_h(λ). UNION-BOUND COVERAGE (separate certificate): if route is α-safe per agent and R(ξ)≤ε then P(collision over [0,τ])≤Σα_i=R(ξ)≤ε.
formal.formal_statement:
Theorem (S2 breakpoint structure). Under A1–A6 below, on λ∈[0,∞):
(i) Concave PL value. g and every g_h are concave, piecewise-linear with ≤|Ξ| pieces; for fixed ξ, λ↦L(ξ,λ) is affine with slope R(ξ)−ε and intercept C(ξ).
(ii) Pareto staircase. There exist 0=λ_0<λ_1<…<λ_K<λ_{K+1}=∞ and routes ξ_0,…,ξ_K with ξ_k∈argmin_{ξ∈Ξ}L(ξ,λ) for all λ∈(λ_k,λ_{k+1}); along k, R(ξ_k) is strictly decreasing and C(ξ_k) strictly increasing, and {(R(ξ_k),C(ξ_k))}_k are exactly the supported Pareto-optimal (risk, time) points of (min C, min R) — i.e. the optimizer natively emits a (time, certified-risk) staircase, not a single trajectory.
(iii) Certified topological switching. The map λ↦h*(λ) is piecewise constant. Let K_top={λ_k: h*(λ_k^−)≠h*(λ_k^+)}. At every λ_k∈K_top there exists an agent i with σ_i(ξ*(λ_k^−))=−σ_i(ξ*(λ_k^+)): a passing-side (抢/让) flip. Each such breakpoint is CERTIFIED — λ_k is the (finite-arithmetic computable) solution of g_h(λ_k)=g_{h'}(λ_k) for the two adjacent active classes h≠h', the certificate being the two class-restricted minimizers plus the verification that h,h' are distinct homotopy invariants (A4); hence the switch is a topological event, not a numerical/heuristic artifact.
(iv) Enumeration-independent safety. Every staircase point with R(ξ_k)≤ε satisfies P(collision over the trusted window)≤ε regardless of whether Ξ realizes all 2^m winding classes; enlarging Ξ only inserts affine pieces below the envelope (refines the staircase / lowers the anytime gap) and never invalidates a certified point.
assumptions: A1 (Finite candidate set / honest no-completeness). Ξ is finite and so the winding classes number ≤2^m; concretely Ξ is whatever the lane-augmented RCSP DAG or the seed generator produces (≤5 today). Missing a class only shortens the staircase; it is never assumed exhaustive.
A2 (λ-affine additive Lagrangian). C,R,ε are independent of λ; C is additive over edges and ≥0; R=Σ_i ρ_i. Hence L is affine in λ for every fixed ξ (holds by construction).

A3 (Conformal radius monotonicity). r_i is continuous and strictly decreasing on (0,1) (empirical quantile strictly increasing in coverage 1−α), so ρ_i(ξ)=r_i^{-1}(gap_i(ξ)) is well-defined and strictly decreasing in clearance. Exchangeability holds within the Mondrian class×density cell on tracker outputs (one scoring window per track).

A4 (Topological separation = genuine homotopy classes). For each agent i the passing sides σ_i=±1 are the two homotopy classes of δ_i(t) in ℝ²∖{0} (equivalently in the spacetime cylinder minus the agent world-tube), separated by T_i: no continuous deformation crosses from +1 to −1 without entering the tube. Thus h(ξ) is an integer-valued, locally constant invariant on the collision-free route space.

A5 (Within-class convex (R,C) frontier — STRUCTURAL; the risky one). Inside a fixed winding class the relaxed (q,T) problem has a convex lower-left (R,C) frontier, so g_h is concave PL with the within-class minimizer tracing the frontier monotonically (R↓,C↑ as λ↑). This is clean on the discrete RCSP / convexified problem and is the bridge to the continuous quintic; for the genuinely nonconvex quintic obstacle constraints it is only an approximation realized by per-class seeds + ALM descent.

A5' (General position / non-degeneracy). The points {(R(ξ),C(ξ))} are in general position, so envelope ties are pairwise: generically each breakpoint is either purely intra-class or a single-coordinate passing-side flip, and intra/inter breakpoints do not coincide. Degenerate λ (measure-zero in calibration data) may host simultaneous multi-agent flips.

A6 (Human-hard + separable reallocation). i∈Hum ⇒ ρ_i≤α_i^hard enforced as a hard, non-deflatable constraint at ALL λ (human tube never shrunk below its label-set radius); risk reallocation Σα_i≤ε moves budget only among deflatable non-human agents. The inner allocation is separable (each ρ_i independent given gaps), so R(ξ) is uniquely defined; cross-agent geometric coupling (enlarging one tube forcing a detour that crowds another) is the one place a global monotone/submodular exchange argument is needed and is flagged as the weakest link.
formal.proof_strategy: Lemma 1 (affine pieces): fixed ξ ⇒ L affine in λ, slope R(ξ)−ε [A2]. Lemma 2 (lower envelope): g=min over finite Ξ of affine functions ⇒ concave PL with ≤|Ξ| pieces and breakpoints at pairwise ties — classical parametric LP (Eaves–Zangwill) / pointwise-min-of-affine [A1]. Lemma 3 (staircase = supported Pareto): on a concave PL lower envelope the active slope R(ξ*)−ε is non-increasing, strictly at breakpoints ⇒ R(ξ_k) strictly ↓ and complementary intercept C strictly ↑; Geoffrion's weighted-sum theorem (minimizers of C+λ'R, λ'≥0, are exactly the supported Pareto points; here λ'=λ, drop the constant −λε) identifies {(R_k,C_k)} as the supported (risk,time) frontier. Lemma 4 (winding = locally-constant invariant): σ_i=sign∮ d arg δ_i is integer-valued and continuous on {δ_i(t)≠0 ∀t} ⇒ locally constant; homotopic ⇔ equal σ for a single encounter (Bhattacharya H-signature / braid invariants) [A4] — this upgrades 'argmin changed' to 'class changed = real flip'. Lemma 5 (class decomposition + certified switch): g=min_h g_h with each g_h concave PL (Lemma 2 restricted); h*(λ)=argmin_h g_h is piecewise constant; its breakpoints are crossings g_h=g_{h'} with h≠h', and by Lemma 4 h≠h' forces non-homotopic minimizers ⇒ a passing-side flip in ≥1 coordinate; A5' makes flips single-coordinate and the tie a simple computable equation; certificate = the two class minimizers + tie value + distinct invariants, all finite-arithmetic checkable (conformal rank ceil((n+1)(1−α)) in exact arithmetic per spec §2). Lemma 6 (enumeration-independent safety): per-point coverage P(collision)≤R(ξ)≤ε is the S3 union-bound certificate on the single executed quintic — Bernstein-hull clearance ≥ r_i(α_i) ⇒ τ_ξ outside T_i ⇒ per-agent conformal coverage, union over i; it references only ξ, never Ξ, so safety is independent of class completeness, and adding routes only lowers the envelope. Continuous realization (bridge, A5): each homotopy class is reachable by a seed (generate_detour_seeds ±u/±v or passing_side topology seed); ALM+L-BFGS-B descent cannot cross a tube (R→hard-∞ for human, large for tube) so it stays in-class, making per-seed local minima ≈ g_h and the multi-start min ≈ the envelope — clean on the discrete RCSP, approximate on the nonconvex quintic (A5 caveat).
overclaim_guardrails: STRUCTURE theorem about the parametric argmin, NOT a safety theorem. Safety is the separate S3 conformal union-bound certificate on the executed quintic; it holds per staircase point and is independent of winding-enumeration completeness — incompleteness costs only anytime/Pareto gap, never safety (the marquee STRIDE invariant).

Do NOT claim 'first dual price for risk/cost Pareto' — constrained-MDP / dual chance-constrained SSP (2302.13115) already does price→policy-switch + Pareto, but on a DISCRETE MDP. Claim only: first to CERTIFY breakpoints as topological passing-side switches of a CONTINUOUS full-function planner, priced in CONFORMAL-quantile units, coupling per-agent budget reallocation (Σα_i≤ε) and topology flip in one price λ.

Do NOT claim the parametric-PL / biobjective piecewise-constant-in-λ result as novel — it is textbook (Eaves–Zangwill, Geoffrion weighted-sum). Novelty = the parametrized OBJECT (continuous winding class), the UNITS (conformal tube radius), and the CERTIFICATION of breakpoints as homotopy switches.

Only the SOUND direction is asserted: class breakpoints ARE passing-side switches. 'Flipping winding lowers makespan-for-risk' is heuristic and geometry-dependent (A5); the theorem does not assert any flip is beneficial (mirror the F1 honesty rule).

Human ∈ label-set is HARD and non-deflatable at ALL λ (A6): α_human capped, human tube never shrunk; reallocation touches only non-human agents; the staircase never trades human safety for time at any price. Branches ② (occlusion shadow r_occ+v_max·t) and ③ (body-clearance floor) are deterministic and OUTSIDE this theorem — R is the ε_cls+ε_pred budget for detected+classified agents (branch ①) only.

Scope: per-detected-track, per-planning-episode, static prediction snapshot; conditioned on commit<τ_trust=0.75s (moving constraints trusted only on [0,τ], receding-horizon re-cert) and on the named conformal assumptions (Mondrian class×density exchangeability on tracker outputs, speed bound, non-reactive agents → performativity goes to limitations). NOT per-mission, NOT closed-loop/reactive, NOT a coverage claim on SDD (certificate calibrated on Isaac onboard renders only).

General-position caveat (A5'): at degenerate λ (measure-zero) simultaneous multi-agent flips or coincident intra/inter breakpoints can occur; the single-coordinate-flip statement is generic, not universal.

The clean theorem lives on the discrete risk-weighted (station,time)×lane RCSP / finite candidate set. The continuous-quintic realization rests on within-class convexity (A5), which is genuinely risky for nonconvex obstacle constraints; do NOT claim global optimality of the per-seed continuous minimizers — state them as in-class local minima realizing the classes.

The weakest assumption is cross-agent coupling in A6 (enlarging one tube forces a detour that crowds another). Absent a proven monotone/submodular exchange structure, R(ξ) separability is exact but global optimality of the joint route+reallocation is only argued per class; flag this explicitly rather than asserting a global exchange argument.
prior_art_to_distinguish: IRA / Feedback-Conformal-IRA (interaction/risk reallocation): redistribute per-agent budget α_i under Σα_i≤ε but within a FIXED route topology — no winding flip, no parametric staircase. We add the topology flip via the SAME price λ and certify its breakpoints.

T-MPC++ / braid- and homotopy-based topology MPC (Knoedler, Alonso-Mora et al.): enumerate winding/braid classes and optimize per class, but use deterministic clearance constraints (not P(collision)≤ε), no dual price, and breakpoints are never certified — they pick best-of-enumerated, with no priced parametric staircase.

Dual-priced constrained-MDP / chance-constrained SSP (arXiv 2302.13115): price→policy-switch + cost/risk Pareto, but on a DISCRETE MDP, not a continuous winding parametrization and not conformal radii. Our object is a continuous full-function (quintic) planner priced in conformal-quantile units.

Classical parametric LP / biobjective weighted-sum (Eaves–Zangwill parametric shortest path; Geoffrion supported Pareto): the piecewise-constant-in-λ lower-envelope result itself is textbook and is NOT claimed novel — only its application to a certified winding-class object in conformal units.
Bhattacharya H-signatures / homotopy & braid path planning: source of the topological invariant (Lemma 4); they do not price it or build a conformal-risk staircase.

Sundarsingh 2509.25124 (nearest competitor): static, joint (non-class-conditional) conformal guarantee; we are dynamic, per-agent class-conditional, and topology-priced. Lindemann 2210.10254: per-step δ/T union vs our max-over-horizon trajectory score (the conformal scoring differentiator).

formal.title: 价格双重身份统一定理 + Pareto 阶梯定理:在连续 spacetime-winding 规划器中,单一 conformal-预算对偶价 λ 同时是 per-agent 预算重分配的 KKT 影子价、与 winding 选择器;其断点是被认证的抢/让同伦切换;λ-扫描原生输出 (时间, 认证风险) 的 Pareto 阶梯
formal.model_setup:
记号与空间(均经 grep 核实,证明可建于其上)。

【轨迹】τ:[0,T_tot]→R^3 为 MINCO s=3 quintic(deg5),由内部 waypoint q∈R^{3(M-1)} 与分段时长 T∈R_{>0}^M 经带状 M(T)c=b(q,BC) 决定(minjerk_traj.hpp:45 PartialPivLU、:18 C2B_matrix、:197 control_points)。记 z:=(q,T)∈Z。T 是直接决策变量(minco_cost_grad.hpp:192 T(i)=x(nq+i)),故 makespan T_tot(z)=Σ_i T_i 在 z 上线性。代价 C(z)=w_time*((T_tot−T_target)/T_target)^2 + w_smooth*J(z)(:236-241 time-anchor + :262-269 min-jerk energy);因 T 自由,C 在 z 上非凸。

【被检测 agent 与 conformal 资源】i=1..N。每 agent 在 Mondrian(类×密度 3×3)格内标定;per-agent 风险预算 α_i∈[0,ᾱ_i]。tube 半径 r_i(α_i)= 在 [0,τ_trust] 窗内对 max-over-horizon 时间整形非一致分数取 1−α_i 经验 conformal 分位(spec line 117 标量化保守 sound;line 49 r=q*ρ)。r_i:[0,ᾱ_i]→R_{≥0} 非增、左连续阶梯(有限标定集);所需 clearance g_i(α_i):=r_i(α_i)+r_body,在 α_i 上非增。

【human 硬地板(label-set 不可放气)】H⊆{1..N}=label-set 含 human 者(latch:进过 human 集合永久 human,spec §1)。i∈H:α_i≤ᾱ^H(小、固定;预算不可从 human 约束上挪走);i∉H:α_i 自由。

【预测与认证风险】总预测风险预算 Σ_i α_i≤ε,此处 ε=ε_pred=0.08;分类预算 ε_cls=0.02 是 union P≤ε_cls+ε_pred 中可加的、非本程序决策项(spec line 35)。基线=当前实现的均匀分 α=ε_pred/H_bin(spec line 52)——本定理把它换成被定价的 water-filling。认证风险 R(ε):=Σ_i α_i*(ε)≤ε,保证 P(撞 i)≤α_i*、Boole-union P(撞任一)≤ε_cls+Σ_i α_i*。

【winding/同伦类】在自由 spacetime 柱 X=(R^3 去掉 ∪_i Tube_i)×[0,T_tot] 上,曲线 t↦(τ(t),t) 属于一个 rel-端点路径同伦类 σ∈Σ(单动障=±winding 侧;N 障=约化 braid/H-signature 词)。固定 σ 即固定各段过哪侧→给出单侧(分离超平面/半空间)clearance。现状仅 plan_minco.hpp:168 passing_side(单一几何侧)+ :299/:159 generate_detour_seeds(≤5 个未定价 seed,max_seeds=5),故 σ-索引的被定价多类对象=新代码。

【per-class 参数化 NLP(值函数)】固定 σ、预算 ε:
  V_σ(ε):=min_{z∈Z_σ, α∈[0,ᾱ]} C(z),  s.t. Φ_i^σ(z;g_i(α_i))≤0 ∀i; Σ_i α_i≤ε,
其中 Φ_i^σ≤0 即 S3 的 Bernstein-hull 连续时间证书:(g_i)^2−‖τ−x̂_i‖^2 的全部 Bernstein 系数≤0(复用 control_points/C2B);Z_σ=MINCO 可行集(vmax/amax hinge + 类-σ 侧约束)。
全局值函数 V(ε):=min_{σ∈Σ} V_σ(ε)。
λ-罚(Lagrange 松弛)内值:φ_σ(λ):=min_{z∈Z_σ,0≤α≤ᾱ}[C(z)+λ Σ_i α_i] s.t. Φ_i^σ≤0;φ(λ):=min_σ φ_σ(λ)。
winding 选择器(对偶-argmin 对应):Σ̂(λ):=argmin_{σ∈Σ} φ_σ(λ)。
per-agent tube 价:η_i:=∂C/∂g_i≥0(类 σ 内 agent i 每单位所需 clearance 的边际 makespan,单位 makespan/米)。
formal.formal_statement:
在假设 A1-A6 下,关于上述程序成立三部分。

【第一部分:价格的类内双重身份 = 影子价 = conformal 预算 water-filling】固定 σ、ε 为 generic(V(ε)=V_σ(ε) 且 σ 在某邻域唯一活跃)。在 KKT 极小点 (z*,α*) 处,设预算乘子 λ≥0:
(i) [影子价] V_σ 局部 Lipschitz、方向可导,且当预算约束活跃时 V_σ'(ε)=−λ(否则 λ=0)。
(ii) [conformal 分位上的 water-filling] 对内点 0<α_i*<ᾱ_i:η_i*|r_i'(α_i*)|=λ;对 α_i*=0:η_i*|r_i'(α_i*)|≤λ;对 α_i*=ᾱ_i(被夹,含全部 i∈H 的 human,夹在 ᾱ^H):η_i*|r_i'(α_i*)|≥λ。故单一标量 λ 把所有未被夹 agent 的边际 makespan-节省/单位预算 拉平(water-filling);λ(makespan/风险)经 conformal 斜率 r_i' 把 per-agent tube 价 η_i(makespan/米)换算成预算价:λ=η_i*|r_i'(α_i)|。这是 同一 λ 给 per-agent 预算重分配定价 的身份。

【第二部分:同一 λ 即 winding 选择器;断点被认证】
(i) [对偶身份] φ_σ(λ) 在 λ 上凹、非增;φ(λ)=min_σ φ_σ(λ) 凹;选择器 Σ̂(λ)=argmin_σ φ_σ(λ) 在任一紧区间上是分段常值、含有限断点集 {λ_k} 的单调对应。在第一部分的 generic 原始最优处(乘子 λ(ε)),活跃类满足 σ*(ε)∈Σ̂(λ(ε)):即 同一标量 既是预算影子价 −V'(ε)、又是对偶选出 winding 类的价。这就是统一:一个 λ,两种读法——原始灵敏度 −V'(ε) 与对偶 argmin Σ̂(λ)。
(ii) [被认证的切换] 每个断点 λ_k 由相邻两类的可验证等式 φ_σ(λ_k)=φ_σ'(λ_k)(等价于对应预算 ε_k 处 V_σ(ε_k)=V_σ'(ε_k))刻画,且 Σ̂(λ_k)={σ,σ'} 取值成集。该等式恰是 抢(在更激进 winding 侧)与 让 在 等认证风险下给出等 makespan 的条件——是同伦切换的证书(对照 passing_side 的纯几何选侧:无值比较)。越过 λ_k 翻转 min-makespan 类:min-L 类在断点翻转。

【第三部分:Pareto 阶梯】
(i) [阶梯几何] λ-扫描映射 λ↦(R(λ),C(λ)):=(Σ_i α_i(λ), 对应原始 makespan) 在 (风险 R, 时间 C) 平面描出一条非增曲线:类内由第一部分的预算重分配产生连续 踏面/踢面,在 λ_k 由第二部分的类切换产生 台阶——一条 Pareto 阶梯。
(ii) [Pareto 最优性,supported 子集] 每个生成点对双目标 (min C, min R) 弱 Pareto 最优;且生成集恰为 supported Pareto 点(可达 (R,C) 凸包下边界、被某标量化权 λ 支撑者)。
(iii) [诚实间隙] 真 Pareto 前沿非凸凹陷内的点 不被纯 λ-扫描枚举(线性标量化的已知局限,叠加离散 σ 与 per-class 非凸 NLP)。但由 S3 per-class 证书,每个被枚举点都带 P(撞 i)≤α_i(union≤ε_cls+Σα_i);漏掉的凹陷点 只损 anytime 最优性(到真前沿的有界 gap),绝不损安全。这是 S2↔S3 防火墙:安全独立于 winding 枚举完备性。
assumptions: A1 [存在/达到] 对每个 σ,Z_σ 在相关预算区间非空且 NLP 取到极小(C 经 time-anchor (T_tot−T_target)^2 在 T 上强制、α-盒紧、类-σ 可行集闭——Φ_i^σ 在 (z,g_i) 上多项式连续)。
A2 [正则] 在所算极小点处成立 MFCQ(KKT 乘子存在且乘子集紧),保证影子价/水填的可导性表述。
A3 [conformal 单调] r_i 在 [0,ᾱ_i] 上非增;water-filling 推导用其非增凸松弛 r̃_i 作 optimizer surrogate(或对阶梯 r_i 用 Clarke/单侧导数);g_i=r_i+r_body。部署 tube 必须用真经验分位(秩 ceil((n+1)(1−α)),精确算术)而非 r̃_i。
A4 [genericity/transversality] 在紧预算区间上有限族 {V_σ} 仅有孤立、横截的交叉(无两类在区间上重合);等价地 {φ_σ(λ)} 在孤立 λ 处相交→断点孤立、有限。
A5 [有限类] Σ 有限(admissible winding 类按 horizon 有界长度的 H-signature/braid 词剪枝为有限约化集)。
A6 [对偶 regime] generic ε 处 σ-松弛程序的 per-budget Lagrange gap 为零(V 在其 supported/lower-convex-envelope 点上被 λ-松弛恢复)。仅作 regime 陈述、非全局假设:非 supported(非凸)Pareto 点处强对偶可失败(见第三部分(iii) 与 guardrails)。
A7 [分层可交换性,继承自 spec] Mondrian 类×密度格内标定分数可交换、行人速度上限、确定性膨胀进 tube——证书覆盖性的命名前提(spec §1),本定理把 r_i 视为已正确标定的输入。
formal.proof_strategy:

formal.title: Continuous-time conformal–Bernstein collision-risk certificate on the executed quintic, with safety ⊥ winding-enumeration completeness
formal.model_setup:
Fix one replan epoch. The executed plan is a degree-5 (quintic) C^2 MINCO spline τ:[0,T_tot]→R^3, the concatenation of M segments τ_i, t∈[c_i,c_{i+1}], with per-segment local parameter s=(t−c_i)/T_i∈[0,1] (cum/T from minjerk_traj.hpp:41,201). Each τ_i is given in Bernstein form by its 6 control points P_{i,0..5}∈R^3, P_i = C2B·diag(1,T_i,…,T_i^5)·c_{6i:6i+6} (control_points(), C2B_matrix() at minjerk_traj.hpp:18,197–208). The Bernstein basis B_k^5(s)=C(5,k)s^k(1−s)^5−k is nonnegative on [0,1] and forms a partition of unity (Σ_k B_k^5≡1), so each Cartesian coordinate of τ_i is a convex combination of {P_{i,k}}.

Perception model (Mondrian cell = class×density, 3×3): the tracker emits, for each detected agent i∈{1,…,H}, a predicted mean path x̂_i:[0,T_tot]→R^3 and a tube-radius profile r_i(t;α_i)=q̂_i(α_i)·ρ_i(t)≥0, calibrated by split/Mondrian conformal at miscoverage α_i using the SUP-over-horizon, time-shaped nonconformity score S_i = sup_{t∈[0,T_tot]} ‖x_i(t)−x̂_i(t)‖/ρ_i(t). Ego body = sphere of radius r_body (circumscribing radius for non-spherical bodies). We require x̂_i(t) and r_i(t;α_i)^2 to admit exact piecewise-polynomial Bernstein representations of finite degree on each segment (constant-velocity ⇒ x̂_i linear, r_i piecewise affine ⇒ exact; otherwise a SOUND outer enclosure: ‖τ−x̂_i‖^2 lower-poly-bounded, r_i^2 upper-poly-bounded).

Per agent i and segment seg, define the deficit polynomial f_{i,seg}(s) = (r_i(t(s);α_i)+r_body)^2 − ‖τ_seg(s) − x̂_i(t(s))‖^2, a univariate polynomial of degree D_{i,seg}=max(2·deg τ_seg, 2·deg x̂_i, 2·deg r_i)=max(10, 2 deg r_i). By degree-elevation to common degree D and Bernstein products (Chu–Vandermonde convolution of control-coefficient sequences) f_{i,seg} has exact Bernstein coefficients b^{(i,seg)}_0,…,b^{(i,seg)}_D, each a closed-form function of {P_{i,k}}, the poly-coeffs of x̂_i, r_i, and r_body — reusing exactly the control-point pipeline already in the codebase (control_points/C2B).

Random source: within a Mondrian cell, calibration agents and the test agent are exchangeable; the only probability is over this draw, conditional on the executed τ. Budgets fixed pre-test: Σ_{i=1}^H α_i ≤ ε_pred, plus ε_cls for the conformal-classification/label-set miscoverage, ε = ε_cls + ε_pred (=0.1 = 0.02+0.08).
formal.formal_statement:
THEOREM (continuous-time conformal–Bernstein certificate). Suppose for every detected agent i and every segment seg, all Bernstein coefficients are nonpositive: b^{(i,seg)}_k ≤ 0 for all k=0,…,D. Then:
(i) [continuous-time clearance] For all t∈[0,T_tot] and all i: ‖τ(t)−x̂_i(t)‖ ≥ r_i(t;α_i)+r_body. (deterministic, given the certified τ.)
(ii) [per-agent risk] Define the collision event C_i={∃t∈[0,T_tot]: ‖τ(t)−x_i(t)‖ < r_body} for the (unknown) true path x_i. Then P(C_i) ≤ α_i, where P is over the Mondrian-cell exchangeable draw and the coverage of the sup-score conformal tube.
(iii) [union] P(∃ agent collision ∪ misclassification) ≤ Σ_i α_i + ε_cls ≤ ε_pred + ε_cls = ε.

LEMMA A (Bernstein range enclosure). For p(s)=Σ_{k=0}^D b_k B_k^D(s) on s∈[0,1]: min_k b_k ≤ p(s) ≤ max_k b_k. In particular b_k≤0 ∀k ⇒ p(s)≤0 ∀s∈[0,1]. (Immediate from B_k^D≥0, Σ_k B_k^D≡1.)

LEMMA B (safety ⊥ enumeration completeness). The predicate Safe(τ) := [∀ i,seg,k: b^{(i,seg)}_k(τ,{x̂_i,r_i,α_i,r_body}) ≤ 0] is a function of a SINGLE trajectory τ and the conformal tube parameters only; it does not reference the winding/braid candidate set 𝒯_enum produced by S2, nor |𝒯_enum|, nor seed-completeness. Hence if τ* is the executed plan with Safe(τ*)=true, statements (i)–(iii) hold for τ* regardless of whether the homotopy enumeration was complete. Incomplete enumeration changes only the achieved makespan / the Pareto frontier returned (an anytime OPTIMALITY gap), or causes a no-feasible-plan abort routed to the RTA backup — it can never falsify the certificate of any certified-and-executed τ.
assumptions: Executed path is a piecewise degree-5 polynomial with control points obtained via C2B (minjerk_traj.hpp:18,197); per-coordinate convex-hull / partition-of-unity property of the Bernstein basis holds.

Predicted mean x̂_i(t) and tube radius r_i(t;α_i) admit EXACT finite-degree piecewise-polynomial Bernstein representations on each segment, OR are replaced by SOUND outer enclosures (poly lower bound on ‖τ−x̂_i‖^2, poly upper bound on r_i^2); soundness, not tightness, is what the theorem needs.

Sup-over-horizon, time-shaped conformal calibration: nonconformity score S_i=sup_t ‖x_i−x̂_i‖/ρ_i(t); a single calibrated quantile q̂_i(α_i) controls the WHOLE continuous trajectory, giving P(∀t: ‖x_i(t)−x̂_i(t)‖ ≤ r_i(t;α_i)) ≥ 1−α_i (no per-step union).

Mondrian-cell exchangeability: calibration agents and the test agent are exchangeable within the (class×density) cell; coverage is cell-conditional. Split-conformal finite-sample bound P(S_i ≤ q̂_i) ≥ ⌈(n+1)(1−α_i)⌉/(n+1) ≥ 1−α_i with n the per-cell calibration count.

Per-agent budgets α_i and the cls/pred split (Σα_i ≤ ε_pred, ε_cls) are fixed BEFORE seeing the test draw, or are drawn from a pre-registered finite grid with a union correction (so the data-dependent S2 dual reallocation does not break marginal coverage).
Ego body is a sphere of radius r_body (or its circumscribing radius for conservativeness); collision = ego sphere intersects agent point.
Calibration is done on TRACKER OUTPUT under the deployment distribution (Isaac onboard render), not SDD.
formal.proof_strategy:
(i) Fix i, seg. By Lemma A, b^{(i,seg)}_k ≤ 0 ∀k ⇒ f_{i,seg}(s) ≤ 0 ∀s∈[0,1] ⇒ ‖τ(t)−x̂_i(t)‖^2 ≥ (r_i(t;α_i)+r_body)^2 ⇒ (both sides ≥0) ‖τ−x̂_i‖ ≥ r_i+r_body, on that segment. The exact Bernstein coeffs of f_{i,seg} come from: square-of-Bernstein = degree-doubling convolution of the segment control points (deg-5 → deg-10 for ‖τ‖^2), products with x̂_i, r_i via Chu–Vandermonde, then degree-elevation to common D — all closed form on {P_{i,k}}. Concatenating the finitely many segments and finitely many agents gives clearance for all t∈[0,T_tot], all i. This is the continuous-time analogue of the sampled-time gate already coded (local_opt_hardalm.hpp seg/ctrl-pt constraints) but made all-t-exact via Lemma A.
(ii) Coverage event T_i={∀t: ‖x_i(t)−x̂_i(t)‖ ≤ r_i(t;α_i)} has P(T_i) ≥ 1−α_i (sup-score conformal). On T_i, triangle inequality + (i): ‖τ(t)−x_i(t)‖ ≥ ‖τ(t)−x̂_i(t)‖ − ‖x_i(t)−x̂_i(t)‖ ≥ (r_i+r_body) − r_i = r_body for all t, so ¬C_i. Thus T_i ⊆ ¬C_i ⇒ C_i ⊆ ¬T_i ⇒ P(C_i) ≤ α_i.
(iii) P(∪_i C_i) ≤ Σ_i P(C_i) ≤ Σ_i α_i ≤ ε_pred (finite union over the H detected agents — the ONLY union, enabled because step (ii) already collapsed the continuous time axis via the sup-score). Add the classification-miss event (true human not in the conformal label-set), P ≤ ε_cls, by one more union: total ≤ ε_pred + ε_cls = ε.
Lemma B: Safe(τ) is evaluated as a pure function of (τ, conformal params); no term in any b^{(i,seg)}_k references 𝒯_enum. The S2 enumeration only selects WHICH feasible τ is fed in (argmin over the certified subset of the candidate set); the guarantee in (i)–(iii) is conditioned on the chosen τ, so it is invariant to |𝒯_enum| and to enumeration completeness. Formalize via: certified output set 𝒞 = {τ∈𝒯_enum : Safe(τ)}; executed τ* ∈ 𝒞 ⇒ guarantee holds; 𝒯_enum ⊆ 𝒯_feasible only affects argmin value (makespan/Pareto-rung), i.e. an anytime gap, never Safe(τ*).
Coverage transfer (finite-sample → continuous-time union): split-conformal gives a finite-sample marginal bound on the SCALAR sup-score S_i; because S_i is already a supremum over the continuous horizon, that single scalar quantile certifies the entire continuous tube simultaneously — the continuous time axis never enters a union bound, only the finite agent index and the cls/pred split do.
overclaim_guardrails: Scope is the EXECUTED quintic vs the DETECTED/tracked agent set only. S3 says nothing about occluded/unobserved space (FN branch ② deterministic occlusion shadow r_occ+v_max·t) or seen-but-unclassified obstacles (FN branch ③ depth→occupancy clearance gate). Do NOT claim S3 covers FN-induced collisions — those are separate, never-cut branches.

The probability is MARGINAL over Mondrian-cell exchangeable draws, conditional on the executed τ. It is NOT a per-flight frequentist guarantee, NOT adversarial, and degrades under distribution shift; coverage is only cell-conditional, not fully conditional on the specific scene geometry.

Validity requires the budgets α_i and ε_cls/ε_pred split to be pre-registered or grid-corrected. The S2 dual price λ reallocates α_i using test-time geometry; if α_i is genuinely data-dependent, the naive Σα_i union over-claims unless a finite-grid union correction (or calibration-independent allocation) is used. State this explicitly — it is the load-bearing honesty point linking S2↔S3.

Bernstein nonpositivity is SUFFICIENT, not necessary: the test is conservative; clearance can hold while some b_k>0. Degree elevation tightens but is exact only in the limit. Report the gap as anytime conservativeness, never as a soundness hole.

Soundness of the polynomial step requires x̂_i, r_i to be exact polynomials OR conservatively OUTER-enclosed. If the learned predictor mean is non-polynomial and only inner/approximate enclosed, the certificate is unsound — must use outer enclosure.
Certificate must be calibrated on tracker output under the deployment renderer (Isaac), never SDD; SDD-calibrated tubes void coverage. This is a hard rule, not a guardrail to relax.

‘P(collision)≤ε’ is for collision with conformally-tubed detected agents under the sphere-body model; human label is a hard (non-deflatable) constraint inside the label-set, so its α_i cannot be inflated to buy makespan.

Lemma B claims safety is independent of enumeration COMPLETENESS, not that enumeration is unnecessary: completeness still governs the anytime optimality/Pareto coverage. Do not over-state as ‘enumeration-free safe’.
prior_art_to_distinguish: T-MPC / T-MPC++ (Topology-driven MPC, braid/homotopy enumeration): continuous-time but DETERMINISTIC collision constraints, no P≤ε, no conformal calibration, no certified safety-vs-enumeration independence.

MADER / FASTER (Tordesillas): continuous-time clearance via separating-hyperplane / MINVO-Bernstein control-point enclosure — deterministic geometric certificate, NOT a probabilistic conformal bound; our novelty is coupling the same Bernstein-hull enclosure with a conformal tube to get P≤α_i.

Bezier/Bernstein reachability and Bezier-HOCBF (e.g. control-point CBF papers): control-point enclosure is deterministic; HOCBF variants certify only at SAMPLED times — we give all-t conformal risk (and F4 separately certifies the CBF inequality itself).

Conformal-prediction MPC for trajectories (Lindemann et al. 2023; Dixit et al.; Sun et al.): DISCRETE-TIME, per-step union over the horizon (Bonferroni over time steps). We collapse the time axis with a sup-over-horizon time-shaped score and enclose continuous time via Bernstein — no per-step union.

IRA / Fb-CP-IRA (iterative/feedback conformal risk allocation): allocate per-agent budget but discrete-time and do NOT produce a continuous-time Bernstein certificate nor the enumeration-independence lemma.

Robust/time-uniform conformal prediction (Cleaveland et al., adaptive/robust CP): provides sup-score / time-uniform tubes — cite as the coverage primitive we BUILD ON; our contribution is the Bernstein continuous-time clearance on the executed quintic + Lemma B (safety ⊥ enumeration completeness), not the tube construction itself.

Constrained-MDP / dual chance-constrained SSP (e.g. 2302.13115): price→policy-switch with cost/risk Pareto, but DISCRETE MDP, not continuous winding, not conformal — relevant to S2, distinguished here to avoid conflating S3's certificate with that line.

formal.title: 语义安全层惯性路由的单向 soundness:独立对称不定分解的惯性 = ∇²F 的 Sylvester 惯性,且其符号唯一地认证「负曲率严格下降方向存在」或「当前 winding 类内的认证-不安全严格局部极小」
formal.model_setup: 决策变量取 MINCO 平坦消元后的约化坐标 x = (q, T) ∈ ℝ^{n_x},n_x = 3(M−1)+M,其中 q∈ℝ^{(M−1)×3} 为内部 waypoint、T∈ℝ^M_{>0} 为段时长(对照 minco_cost_grad.hpp:188–192,T(i)=x(nq+i) 为直接决策变量,非 exp(τ))。系数 c 已被 MINCO 映射 c = M(T)^{-1} b(q) 闭式消去(minjerk_traj.hpp:159–161 单次 PartialPivLU 前向解),故总代价 F(x) = F(q,T) 在 {T>0} 上原生地只是约化坐标的函数——「约化 Hessian」即此平坦目标的 Hessian,无需再做约束消元。固定一个 winding/同伦类 h(由 generate_detour_seeds 选定的单一 passing-side 拓扑,plan_minco.hpp:168/299),并固定 hinge/max 项的活动集 A(使 F 在邻域内 C²);记 H := ∇²F(x*) ∈ ℝ^{n_x×n_x} 对称。记 ρ(x*) 为该点由独立的 S2/S3 conformal 风险层认证的剩余语义碰撞风险上界(P(撞)上界或连续时间 clearance 残量),ε 为风险阈值(主线 ε=0.1)。惯性记 In(H)=(n_+,n_-,n_0)。独立对称不定分解指对 H(绝不对 M(T))做 Bunch–Kaufman/LDLᵀ:P H Pᵀ = L D Lᵀ,D 为 1×1 与 2×2 对称块的块对角阵。
formal.formal_statement:
设 F 在 x* 的某邻域 N 内 C²(固定活动集 A),H=∇²F(x*),P H Pᵀ = L D Lᵀ 为 H 的任一 Bunch–Kaufman 分解,L 非奇异。则:
(A) [惯性正确性,Sylvester] In(D) = In(H)。即从对称分解块 D 直接读出的 (n_+,n_-,n_0) 等于 ∇²F 的惯性。(因 H 与 D 经非奇异 L 合同,合同保持惯性。)
(B) [n_-≥1 ⇒ 严格负曲率下降方向存在,且可构造、数值可 sound 检测] 若 n_-≥1,则存在并可由 D 的某负 1×1 主元或带负特征值的 2×2 块经 L 回代构造出 v≠0 使 vᵀHv<0;若同时 ∇F(x*)=0,则 ∀ 足够小 s>0,F(x*+sv) = F(x*) + (s²/2)vᵀHv + o(s²) < F(x*)(严格下降)。在带向后稳定的 BK 选主元下,所报 n_- 是某个与 H 相距 O(u·‖H‖)(u=机器精度)的对称阵的惯性;故在特征间隙条件 |λ_min(H)| ≥ δ > c·u·‖H‖ 下,n_-≥1 的检测是 sound 的(不会把正定误判为不定)。
(C) [PD ∧ 残余风险超阈 ⇒ 认证-不安全严格局部极小 ⇒ sound 触发翻 winding] 若 n_-=n_0=0(即 H≻0)且 ∇F(x*)=0,则 x* 是 F 在类 h 内的严格局部极小(二阶充分条件),从而类 h 内不存在下降方向;若再有 ρ(x*) > ε,则 x* 为「类 h 内认证-不安全的严格局部极小」,连续局部优化在类 h 内无法逃逸——因此路由到离散动作(翻 spacetime winding / 重选 passing-side 同伦类)是 sound 的触发判据。
单向性:本命题只断言上述触发方向(必要型 soundness);不断言其逆,也不断言翻 winding 后必达安全类(后者属启发)。
(D) [独立性必要] M(T)(minjerk_traj.hpp:76–161)是非对称带状约束映射,solve_adjoint(:261–266)用其转置 LU 坐实 M≠Mᵀ;它既非代价 Hessian、其 PartialPivLU 的 U 对角符号又与 H 的特征值符号无合同关系。故 (A)–(C) 的惯性路由必须由对 H 的独立对称不定分解给出,复用 M(T) 的 LU 不能给出 In(∇²F)。
assumptions: x* 由 L-BFGS-B 返回且满足一阶平稳 ‖∇F(x*)‖ ≤ tol(在 (B) 严格下降与 (C) 局部极小判定中均用到平稳性;非平稳点改取与 −∇F 对齐的 v 仍为下降方向,但严格二阶论证需平稳)
在 x* 的邻域 N、固定 hinge/max 活动集 A 下 F∈C²:即 obstacle-soft/vel-hinge/accel-hinge/ALM-PHR/corridor 各项的活动分支被冻结(active-set 局部光滑化),H=∇²F(x*) 在该分支上良定且对称
T(i)>0(段时长严格为正,MINCO 良态,M(T) 可逆;约化坐标 F 在 {T>0} 开集内定义)
特征间隙条件:|λ_min(H)| ≥ δ,δ 大于 BK 向后误差界 c·u·‖H‖,以保证有限精度下惯性符号判定 sound
winding/同伦类 h 在该优化回合内固定(惯性只对当前类内的 F 求;翻类后是另一个 F_{h'})
ρ(x*) 与 ε 来自独立的 S2/S3 conformal 风险认证层,在 x* 上独立求得,不由本路由层产生
Bunch–Kaufman 选主元向后稳定(标准 LAPACK xSYTRF 类实现);若用未选主元 LDLᵀ 则需附加块条件数界
formal.proof_strategy: (A) Sylvester 合同惯性定律:H = P^{-1}(LDLᵀ)P^{-T},L 与置换非奇异 ⇒ H 与 D 合同 ⇒ In(H)=In(D)。BK 的 D 为 1×1/2×2 块对角,逐块算惯性(2×2 块用其行列式与迹定号)累加即得 In(H)。(B) 由 In(D) 中负惯性指数 n_-≥1,取一个负 1×1 主元 e_j(D_{jj}<0)或一个不定 2×2 块的负特征向量 w(块内 2 维直接特征分解),令 y 为把它嵌入全空间的向量,则 v 由 Lᵀ Pᵀ-回代 v = Pᵀ L^{-T} y 得到,满足 vᵀHv = yᵀ D y < 0(合同下二次型同号)。平稳点处二阶 Taylor:F(x*+sv)−F(x*) = (s²/2)vᵀHv + o(s²),系数严格负 ⇒ 充分小 s 严格下降。有限精度 soundness:BK 向后稳定给出 computed D = inertia of H+ΔH,‖ΔH‖≤c·u·‖H‖;在间隙 δ 下 H+ΔH 与 H 同惯性(特征值连续 + Weyl 扰动界)⇒ 报告的 n_- 真。(C) 二阶充分条件:∇F(x*)=0 ∧ H≻0 ⇒ x* 严格局部极小(标准),故类 h 内 F 在 x* 无下降方向(连续优化驻留);叠加独立认证 ρ(x*)>ε 得「认证-不安全严格局部极小」标签,这是「连续层在类 h 内已穷尽」的 sound 证据,故 sound 地路由到离散翻类动作。(D) 反例/区分:M(T) 行块结构(minjerk_traj.hpp:82–157)非对称,solve_adjoint 必须解 Mᵀ(:261–266)⇒ M≠Mᵀ;非对称 LU 的 U 对角符号在一般情形不等于特征值符号(惯性非合同不变于 LU),且 M(T) 是约束映射而非 ∇²F,二者维度/语义皆异 ⇒ 必须新建对称分解(项目内无 LDLᵀ/BK/inertia,需新代码,可用 Eigen 自带对称分解或外接 LAPACK xSYTRF)。F2 的 Hvp(复用 solve_adjoint + dM_dT_times_c + d²M/dT²)可为该对称分解或 Lanczos 极端特征对提供矩阵-向量乘,但分解本身必须对称不定、独立于 M(T) LU。
overclaim_guardrails: 单向陈述:仅 n_-≥1 ⇒ 下降方向存在;PD∧ρ>ε ⇒ 翻 winding 触发。绝不陈述逆命题、不陈述翻 winding 后必到安全类(翻有用 = 启发,明确标注)
不 claim「首个用惯性/负曲率做优化」:负曲率逃鞍、modified-Newton、trust-region 早有;新颖点仅限『路由 target/语义』——把 Sylvester 惯性 ∧ 独立认证残余语义风险 ρ>ε 用作『当前同伦类已穷尽』的认证标签,触发离散拓扑切换,而非用作步长/正则修正
明确区分 IPOPT inertia-correction:后者用 KKT 矩阵惯性决定加多少 δI 正则以让分解获得『可继续同一连续 Newton 迭代』的正确惯性;本命题反向——不加正则修复,而是把 PD 惯性当作连续层在类内的终止证据去触发离散翻类。两者共享 Sylvester 原语但 routing target 相反
C² / 固定活动集假设必须写明:hinge 与 max/ALM 项使 F 仅分片 C²;∇²F 与全部二阶结论限定在冻结活动集邻域;活动集切换处不声称(可退化为方向导数/Clarke 广义 Hessian,但本命题不 claim 该推广)
有限精度 soundness 受特征间隙 δ 约束:近零特征值(|λ|<c·u·‖H‖)处不声称惯性判定 sound;须报告 δ 并在间隙不足时降级为『不确定』而非误报
ρ>ε 的认证强度只继承自独立 S2/S3 层;本路由层不重新证明 ρ 的有效性,仅消费其输出;故整体安全保证不强于该 conformal 层
不与 S2 对偶价格 λ 的断点认证混为一谈:本命题不认证抢/让同伦切换的『最优性/Pareto 阶梯』,只认证『当前类内连续优化已穷尽 ⇒ 应离散切换』这一触发,且不保证完备枚举(枚举不全只损 anytime gap,不损本触发的 soundness)
必须用独立对称不定分解(BK/LDLᵀ);严禁复用 M(T) 的非对称 PartialPivLU 推断惯性——M≠Mᵀ(solve_adjoint 转置解为证)且 M 非代价 Hessian
prior_art_to_distinguish: IPOPT / 内点法 inertia-correction(Wächter–Biegler):用 KKT 矩阵惯性 + 加 δI 正则保证下降步,routing target = 步长修正/继续同一连续迭代;本命题用惯性触发离散拓扑翻转,语义相反
经典负曲率逃鞍 / modified-Newton / trust-region(More–Sorensen、Conn–Gould–Toint):负曲率方向用于连续优化下降,非用于同伦类穷尽判定 + 语义风险触发
Sylvester 惯性定律 / Bunch–Kaufman 对称不定分解(教科书):本命题的 (A)(B) 数学核心即此,故不 claim 数学新颖,只 claim 在 planner-SEMANTIC 安全层的新路由 target
T-MPC++ / braids 拓扑 MPC:枚举/选 winding 拓扑,但不用 Hessian 惯性判定『类内已穷尽』、不与认证语义风险耦合
S2 对偶价格 λ 断点认证(本仓库另一存活核):λ_k 认证抢/让同伦切换并输出 (时间,风险) Pareto 阶梯;本命题不认证最优性/Pareto,只给单向触发 soundness,二者互补不重叠
S5/F1 必须用独立对称分解 vs 复用 M(T) LU:M(T)(minjerk_traj.hpp:45,159)是非对称约束映射(solve_adjoint:261 用转置 LU 为证),其 LU 不揭示 In(∇²F);区分点 = 惯性必须来自对 H 的独立对称不定分解

formal.title: MINCO 平坦消元约简 Hessian 的二阶伴随 matvec:基于单次 M(T) 分解的精确装配定理与 O(M·b²)/Hvp 复杂度
formal.model_setup:
记 d=3,段数 M,半带宽 b=O(1)(常数,经 minjerk_traj.hpp::solve() 行 82-157 装配逐项核实,M(T) 的非零条带跨度 ≤ ~10,与 M 无关)。决策变量 z=(q,T),q∈R^{(M-1)×d}(内部 waypoint),T∈R^M_{>0}(段时长),nq=3(M-1),n=6M。

状态(系数)c∈R^{n×d} 由平坦映射隐式确定:M(T)·c = b(q)(minjerk_traj.hpp:76-161;同列共享同一 M(T),3 列各自一组 RHS)。其中:
 (i) b(q) 仅在行 6i+5 携带 q_i(行 130 b.row(base+5)=q.row(i)),其余行为端点常数 ⇒ ∂b/∂q_i = 选择子 e_{6i+5}(关于 z 为常数,∂²b≡0);
 (ii) M(T) 的每个块行仅依赖其自身段时长 T_k(行 91-153 中 t1=T(i) 的幂),跨段耦合项(如 −6,−24,−1)与 T 无关 ⇒ ∂²M/∂T_j∂T_k=0 (j≠k),∂M/∂T_k 仅占段 k(或尾段)的行(由 dM_dT_times_c(k) 行 269-295 给出,块局部 O(1) 非零行)。

定义 c(z):=M(T)^{-1}b(q)。约简目标 F(z):=Φ(c(z),z),Φ 为 minco_cost_grad.hpp:177-321 装配的总代价(energy + vel/accel hinge + soft-obstacle + time-anchor + corridor + hard-ALM)。能量项 J(c,T)(minjerk_traj.hpp:224-256)为 c,T 的多项式 ⇒ 处处 C^∞ 且 Φ_cc,Φ_cz,Φ_zz 块局部闭式;hinge/ALM 项为 C¹ 分段 C²(铰点集 N⊂R^{nq+M} 为零测)。

伴随量(代码约定,grad_from_dcost_dc 行 298-310):λ := M(T)^{-T} Φ_c = solve_adjoint(Φ_c)(行 300);一阶约简梯度恒等式(已 golden 验证):
 G_{q,i}(z) = λ_{[6i+5,:]}(行 302),
 G_{T,k}(z) = Φ_{T_k} − ⟨λ, (∂M/∂T_k)c⟩(行 303-307,⟨·,·⟩ 为 6M×3 上的 Frobenius 内积)。
Φ_c=dcost_dc,Φ_{T_k}=dT_exp。⟨·,·⟩ 与代码 (lam.array()*dMc.array()).sum() 一致。

待证对象:沿任意方向 v=(v_q,v_T)∈R^{nq+M} 的约简 Hessian-向量积 ∇²F(z)·v,以及其装配复杂度。
formal.formal_statement:
【定理 A(二阶伴随 matvec 装配恒等式)】设 z∉N(Φ 在 z 处二次可微),M(T) 非奇异(T_i>0)。对任意 v=(v_q,v_T),依次构造:

(T1 切线状态,一次前向解,复用 solve() 的单次 LU):
 ċ := M(T)^{-1}[ (∂b/∂q)v_q − Ṁ c ],  其中 Ṁ := Σ_k v_{T,k} (∂M/∂T_k),(∂b/∂q)v_q 把 v_{q,i} 置入行 6i+5,Ṁc 经 Σ_k v_{T,k}·dM_dT_times_c(k) 装配。

(T2 二阶伴随,一次转置解,复用同一 LU 经 solve_adjoint):
 λ̇ := M(T)^{-T}[ Φ_cc[ċ] + Φ_cz[v] − Ṁ^T λ ]。

(装配)定义向量 Hv,其分量为:
 Hv_{q,i} = λ̇_{[6i+5,:]}                                  …(HQ)
 Hv_{T,k} = Φ_{T_k c}[ċ] + Φ_{T_k z}[v] − ⟨λ̇, (∂M/∂T_k)c⟩ − v_{T,k}⟨λ, (∂²M/∂T_k²)c⟩ − ⟨λ, (∂M/∂T_k)ċ⟩   …(HT)
其中 (∂M/∂T_k)c 复用 dM_dT_times_c(k);(∂M/∂T_k)ċ 为同一块局部线性映射作用于 ċ(dM_dT_times_c 的平凡推广);(∂²M/∂T_k²)c 为新增块局部原语 d²M/dT²(对 t1=T_k 的幂逐项二次微分,支撑同 dM_dT_times_c(k) 的行)。

则在精确算术下,Hv = ∇²F(z)·v(逐分量相等)。

【定理 B(复杂度,无再分解)】记一次 M(T) 的分解在 solve() 中完成且被全程复用(行 159)。则:
 (B1)每次 Hvp 仅需 1 次前向三角回代 + 1 次转置三角回代(共享该单次分解)+ O(M) 个块局部装配(每块 O(b²) 功):
  • 若 M(T) 以半带宽 b 的带状因子分解,两次三角解各 O(M·b)·d,装配 O(M·b²) ⇒ 每 Hvp = Θ(M·b²),b 为常数则线性于 M;
  • 全程无任何重新分解(切线 T1 与二阶伴随 T2 复用同一 LU 的前向/转置回代)。
 (B2)用 Lanczos/隐式重启对约简 Hessian 取 k 个极端特征对:每次仅一个 Hvp,k 个极端对在 O(k) 次迭代收敛 ⇒ O(k·M·b²),始终无再分解。
 (B3)由此在 MINCO 平坦消元后的 (q,T) 约简问题上达到 solver 级二阶可行(matrix-free Newton-CG / 负曲率探测),而标准实现仅一阶 L-BFGS。

【诚实复杂度叙事】O(M)/O(M·b²) 的优势仅在大 M 显现:长 horizon、细时间分辨率(多短段)、高分辨率走廊、或多 arm/多 agent 批量(段数累加)。部署常见 M≤12 时,带状/大-M 渐近退化为常数,此处收益是常数因子(解析 Hvp + 零再分解),非渐近;须明确给出"O(M) 真显现 regime"叙事并承认 M≤12 退化。又:当前 C++ 用稠密 Eigen::PartialPivLU(行 45,159),其三角解为 O(n²)=O(M²);(B1) 的 O(M·b²) 需替换为带状因子(M(T) 客观带状,即 Python 侧 scipy solve_banded 系统),"无再分解"在现稠密实现下亦成立,O(M·b²) 需带状变体。
assumptions: z∉N:Φ 在 z 处二次可微(排除 hinge/ALM 铰点零测集 N;否则取 a.e. 广义 Hessian,装配恒等式按选定的活动分片成立)
M(T) 非奇异(全部 T_i>0;solve() 的 LU 存在,已由 golden 19/19 间接保证)
原语一致性:d²M/dT² 与 dM_dT_times_c 同源块局部(对 T_k 幂逐项二次微分),且 dM_dT_times_c 推广为作用于任意系数矩阵(c 与 ċ 皆可)
∂²M/∂T_j∂T_k=0 (j≠k) 与 ∂²b≡0:经 solve() 装配逐项核实(每块行仅含其自身 T_k 的幂;b 中 q 为线性选择)——这是 (HT) 中仅出现 v_{T,k}⟨λ,∂²M/∂T_k²·c⟩ 单项、无跨段二阶项的前提

(B1) 的 O(M·b²):假定带状因子分解(半带宽 b=O(1));现稠密 PartialPivLU 实现下退化为 O(M²)/Hvp,但'无再分解'与装配恒等式不依赖该假定
(B2):Lanczos 取 k 个极端对的 O(k) 迭代数为标准谱间隙下的典型界,非最坏情形保证
formal.proof_strategy:
(A 装配恒等式)Pearlmutter 'fast exact Hessian' 的 R-算子 / 二阶伴随特化到 MINCO 闭式平坦映射。
1. 一阶恒等式来源:对 Lagrangian L=Φ+⟨μ, M(T)c−b(q)⟩,状态最优 ⇒ M c=b;选 μ 使 ∂L/∂c=0 得伴随;代码取 λ:=M^{-T}Φ_c(符号即 −μ),已由 grad_from_dcost_dc golden 验证给出 G_q,G_T(见 model_setup)。证明从这两个 golden 恒等式出发逐项求方向导数。

(B 复杂度)
8. 带状 LU:M(T) 半带宽 b=O(1)(逐项核实),带状 LU 一次 O(M b²),每次三角回代 O(M b)(×d);切线+伴随=2 解 ⇒ O(M b)·d。装配:O(M) 个块各 O(b²)(局部 matvec + Φ 块局部二阶导)⇒ O(M b²)。合计每 Hvp Θ(M b²),无再分解(同一因子用于前向与转置)。

formal.title: Bernstein-HOCBF continuous-time soundness: de-Casteljau-subdivided control-point nonnegativity certifies the high-order CBF invariance inequality (not just clearance) along an executed quintic against an analytic predicted motion ball, in O(M·r), with a sound DYN_INFEASIBLE routing witness
formal.model_setup:
Trajectory. τ:[0,T_tot]→R^3 is the committed/executed MINCO quintic with M segments (sando::MinjerkTraj, minjerk_traj.hpp). On segment i (s∈[0,T_i]) each coordinate of τ_i is degree-5; its degree-5 Bernstein (Bezier) control points are exactly C2B_matrix()·diag(1,T_i,…,T_i^5)·c_seg = control_points()[i] (minjerk_traj.hpp:18,197), with wall-clock node times cum(i)+(k/5)T_i (control_point_times(), :212).

Obstacle / moving safety ball. For a tracked agent i, the prediction supplies a center x̂_i:[0,T_tot]→R^3 and a (conformal) tube radius r_i(·); together with body radius r_body they define a time-varying ball B_i(t)={y:‖y−x̂_i(t)‖≤r_i(t)+r_body}. ASSUME x̂_i and r_i are polynomial (or piecewise-polynomial with breakpoints refined to the segment grid) of degree ≤ p in t — the "analytic predicted motion ball."

Barrier. Squared-clearance h_i(t):=‖τ(t)−x̂_i(t)‖² − (r_i(t)+r_body)². h_i≥0 ⟺ τ(t)∉int B_i(t). Because τ,x̂_i,r_i are polynomial, h_i is, per segment, an exact polynomial of degree D_h=2·max(5,p).

HOCBF chain. Fix locally-Lipschitz polynomial class-K functions α_1,…,α_ρ (e.g. linear α_j(z)=κ_j z, κ_j>0) and set ψ_0:=h_i, ψ_j:=ψ̇_{j-1}+α_j(ψ_{j-1}), j=1..ρ, where ρ is the relative degree of h_i under the assumed agent/ego kinematics. Each ψ_j is, per segment, an exact polynomial of degree ≤D_h. The continuous-time HOCBF invariance condition on segment i is ψ_j(s)≥0 ∀s∈[0,T_i], j=0..ρ (it suffices to certify the top inequality ψ_ρ≥0 plus boundary values ψ_j(0)≥0, j<ρ).

Bernstein test operator. For a degree-D polynomial p on [0,T_i] with Bernstein coefficients b∈R^{D+1}: p(s)=Σ_k b_k B_{k,D}(s/T_i). De-Casteljau subdivision to depth r partitions [0,T_i] into 2^r equal sub-intervals and yields refined coefficient vectors b^{(r)}_j∈R^{D+1}, j=1..2^r, each the exact Bernstein form of p restricted to sub-interval j. Define NONNEG_r(p):=⋀_{j,k} (b^{(r)}_{j,k}≥0).
formal.formal_statement:
Let segment i of τ and ball B_i be as above, with each ψ_j (j=0..ρ) the exact per-segment polynomial of the HOCBF chain.

(I) Soundness (sufficiency). For any depth r≥0: if NONNEG_r(ψ_j) holds, then ψ_j(s)≥0 for all s∈[0,T_i]. In particular, if NONNEG_r(ψ_ρ) holds AND ψ_j(0)≥0 for j=0..ρ−1, then by the HOCBF comparison/forward-invariance lemma the whole chain stays nonnegative on the segment, hence h_i(t)≥0 ∀t∈[seg i] (zero in-segment collision with B_i), provided h_i at the segment start ≥0.

(II) Termination / anytime-completeness. Suppose ψ_j(s)≥ε>0 ∀s∈[0,T_i] and ‖ψ_j''‖_∞≤B on the segment. Then the control-point/true-value gap of subdivided Bernstein form decays as max_{j,k} (ψ_j − b^{(r)}_{j,k}) ≤ C_D·B·T_i²·2^{−2r} (margin decay rate; C_D depends only on degree D). Hence NONNEG_r(ψ_j) holds for all r≥r*:=⌈½ log2(C_D B T_i²/ε)⌉, a finite depth. Thus every strictly-feasible segment is certified at finite depth, while a segment with ψ_j touching 0 may never certify (sound but, on the zero set, incomplete).

(III) Cost. For fixed polynomial degree D, computing all b^{(r)}_j by repeated de Casteljau costs O(2^r·D²) per segment, i.e. O(M·2^r·D²); under a fixed depth budget r=r_max (equivalently a fixed number of refinement passes) this is O(M·r_max) up to the D² constant — the claimed O(M·r).

(IV) Routing hook (sound failure). If NONNEG_{r_max}(ψ_ρ) fails, emit DYN_INFEASIBLE(seg i, sub-interval j*, index k*, witness value b^{(r_max)}_{j*,k*}<0). This is a sound certificate of non-verification (NOT a proof of collision), consumed only as a routing/recovery trigger (e.g. winding-flip seed in plan_minco.hpp:299 generate_detour_seeds, or recovery.hpp:16 yield_target); the safety guarantee (I) is asserted only when the test passes.
assumptions: Analytic predicted motion ball: x̂_i(t) and r_i(t) are polynomial (or piecewise-polynomial with breaks aligned/refinable to the MINCO segment grid) in t of degree ≤ p; only then are h_i and the chain ψ_j EXACT polynomials with a finite Bernstein representation. Non-polynomial predictions require a (conservative) polynomial outer-enclosure of x̂_i and r_i, which weakens the guarantee to the enclosure.

ego/agent kinematics give a well-defined finite relative degree ρ for h_i, and the class-K functions α_1..α_ρ are polynomial and locally Lipschitz with α_j(0)=0 (so each ψ_j is polynomial and the comparison lemma applies).

the certificate is A-POSTERIORI on an ALREADY-COMPUTED trajectory τ (like S3): it verifies the polynomial inequality ψ_ρ≥0 along τ; it does NOT synthesize a controller nor prove existence of an admissible control input realizing τ.
boundary seeding: ψ_j(0)≥0 for j=0..ρ−1 (checked exactly at the segment start node) — needed to lift the top-inequality certificate to forward invariance of the whole chain.
h_i uses the SQUARED clearance so it is polynomial; the genuine (non-squared) signed distance is recovered only where h_i≥0, which is exactly the certified region.

Bernstein form of h_i is degree D_h=2·max(5,p); since C2B_matrix()/control_points() are degree-5 only, h_i's coefficients are obtained by Bernstein products (binomial-weighted discrete convolution of the degree-5 hulls of τ and x̂_i) plus elevation — elementary but NEW arithmetic, not a literal call to control_points().
fixed polynomial degree D for the O(M·r) cost statement; D grows with prediction degree p and with ρ via derivatives, so the constant is regime-dependent.
formal.proof_strategy:
Soundness (I): Bernstein basis functions B_{k,D}≥0 and Σ_k B_{k,D}≡1 on [0,1] (partition of unity); hence p(s)≥min_k b_k, so all-nonneg coefficients ⇒ p≥0. De Casteljau subdivision yields, on each sub-interval, the EXACT Bernstein coefficients of the same polynomial (no approximation), so NONNEG_r ⇒ pointwise nonneg on every sub-interval ⇒ on [0,T_i]. Lifting top inequality to full chain = standard HOCBF nested-comparison-lemma / Gronwall argument (Xiao–Belta), using α_j Lipschitz class-K and the boundary seeds.
Termination (II): classic Bernstein range-enclosure convergence — the control polygon converges quadratically to the curve under subdivision: gap ≤ C_D·‖p''‖_∞·(subinterval length)² (Garloff/Cargo–Shisha second-difference bound), giving the 2^{−2r} rate and the explicit r*. Strict positivity ε>0 then forces all coefficients positive past r*.
Cost (III): de Casteljau split of a degree-D segment is O(D²); a depth-r binary tree has 2^r leaves but a fixed-budget/fixed-pass scheme touches O(r) levels with the D² constant; summed over M segments → O(M·r). Optional sharpening: Lanczos/interval pruning not needed.
Construction of ψ_j Bernstein coeffs: take degree-5 hulls of τ (control_points(), minjerk_traj.hpp:197) and the predicted center; form ‖τ−x̂‖² and (r+r_body)² by Bernstein products (convolution with C(D,k) weights) and subtract → h_i coeffs; differentiate in Bernstein form (forward differences ×D/T_i) and add α_j(ψ_{j-1}) (degree-elevate to common D) → ψ_j coeffs. All exact rational maps of the stored MINCO coefficients c.
Routing (IV): on failure return the most-negative leaf coefficient as witness; feed seg/side to existing detour/winding-flip and yield primitives. Failure ⇏ collision (only ⇏ certificate), so anytime-soundness is preserved.
overclaim_guardrails: Do NOT claim novelty of the Bernstein/MINVO convex-hull bounding idea itself — it is standard (MADER, FaSTrack-style hulls, MINVO basis, Garloff Bernstein global optimization). The increment is: certifying the HOCBF *inequality semantics* ḣ+α(h)≥0 (a forward-invariance/barrier statement with a margin-decay rate) rather than a clearance/separation distance, on an executed quintic, with an explicit DYN_INFEASIBLE routing witness.

Do NOT claim first continuous-time CBF verification in general — SOS/SDP CBF verification exists (Ames, Clark). Scope the claim to: an LP/SDP-free, local, de-Casteljau-subdivision certificate with explicit 2^{−2r} margin-decay and per-leaf witness on piecewise-quintic MINCO segments.
Soundness only: the test is SUFFICIENT, not necessary, at any fixed depth; on the ψ=0 boundary it may never certify. State 'sound + anytime-incomplete', never 'complete'.
It is an a-posteriori certificate on a GIVEN trajectory — it does not synthesize a safe controller and does not prove the closed-loop input realizing τ stays admissible.

Polynomial-prediction assumption is load-bearing: for non-polynomial x̂_i/r_i the guarantee holds only for the polynomial outer-enclosure (added conservatism); must state this, not silently assume it away.
O(M·r) is at FIXED degree D; degree grows with prediction degree p and relative degree ρ, so honestly give the 'small-D / fixed-pass-budget' regime where the bound is meaningful.

WAVE3 avoidance scope: this F4 certificate is about the deterministic/per-segment CBF inequality along τ; it is NOT the marquee S2 dual-price/winding-Pareto result and does NOT by itself deliver the P(collision)≤ε_cls+ε_pred conformal guarantee — that risk-budgeted statement is S3's job (h uses r_i(t) at a fixed α_i budget here). Do not conflate F4's zero-violation-vs-the-ball with a probabilistic collision bound.

The routing/winding-flip trigger is a sound failure SIGNAL only; do NOT claim the flip is guaranteed to restore feasibility (that is heuristic, cf. S5/F1 which only claims sound negative-curvature *detection*).
prior_art_to_distinguish: MADER (Tordesillas & How, T-RO 2022): separating-plane (MIQP) clearance certificate between trajectory Bernstein/MINVO hull and obstacle hull — certifies geometric SEPARATION/clearance, not the CBF differential inequality; no margin-decay-rate, no forward-invariance semantics.

Bezier-/discrete-time-HOCBF methods: enforce HOCBF only at sampled instants or at control points heuristically — no inter-sample (continuous-time) guarantee; F4 closes the inter-sample gap soundly via subdivision.

SOS/SDP CBF verification (Ames, Clark, Parrilo-style): certifies polynomial CBF nonnegativity via semidefinite programming — F4 uses LP/SDP-free de Casteljau subdivision (local, cheap, witness-producing) instead.

HOCBF theory (Xiao & Belta 2019/2022): defines the high-order CBF chain and forward-invariance comparison lemma — F4 reuses this lemma but supplies a continuous-time *verification* certificate on a committed quintic, not a controller-synthesis QP.

Bernstein/MINVO convex-hull trajectory bounding & Bernstein global optimization (Cichella/Kielas-Jensen MINVO; Garloff, Cargo–Shisha subdivision-convergence bounds): supply the underlying hull-nonnegativity and 2^{−2r} convergence — F4's increment is the CBF-inequality application + margin-decay framing + DYN_INFEASIBLE routing hook, NOT the bounding math.

S3 (sibling claim): conformal-tube continuous-time *collision-risk* certificate P(hit i)≤α_i on the squared clearance — F4 differs by certifying the HOCBF *invariance inequality* (with class-K margin dynamics + relative-degree chain), and by emitting the routing witness; the two share the C2B/control_points + Bernstein-hull substrate.

collisions.axis: S3 — post-hoc continuous-time collision risk certificate on the executed quintic: distribution-free conformal-tube radius alpha_i + Bernstein-hull non-positivity of per-segment (r_i(t;alpha_i)+r_body)^2 - ||tau(t)-xhat_i(t)||^2 implies continuous-time clearance >=0, P(collide i)<=alpha_i, union<=eps_cls+eps_pred; safety independent of winding-enumeration completeness.
collisions.prior_art_found: Two ingredients exist SEPARATELY in mature prior art, but no work combines them into a continuous-time post-hoc per-agent probabilistic certificate on a committed polynomial trajectory. (A) Conformal-tube for collision, DISCRETE-TIME and as an MPC CONSTRAINT (not post-hoc certificate): Lindemann/Cleaveland/Pappas "Safe Planning in Dynamic Environments Using CP" (2210.10254); Dixit/Lindemann "Adaptive CP for Motion Planning among Dynamic Agents" (2212.00278); Stamouli "Recursively Feasible Shrinking-Horizon MPC w/ CP" (MLR 2024); Interaction-aware CP for Crowd Navigation (2502.06221, WAFR'24) adds radii inside the MPC; Time-aware Motion Planning w/ CP (2511.18170). ALL enforce the CP radius at discrete prediction steps with a union/Bonferroni over the horizon — the exact per-step union S3 avoids. (B) Bernstein/B-spline convex-hull continuous-time clearance, DETERMINISTIC (no P<=alpha): MADER/PANTHER (2103.06372), Relative-Bernstein RSFC (1909.10219), B-spline real-time quad planning (1904.12348). (C) CP as post-hoc/predictive RUNTIME certificate: Lindemann/Pappas "CP for STL Runtime Verification" (2211.01539) and robust version (2311.09482) — closest post-hoc framing, but discrete signal, STL satisfaction probability, no Bernstein continuous-time clearance on a polynomial trajectory. (D) Conformal-risk-control + CBF giving formal P(constraint sat): Gonzales/Leung "Safe Probabilistic Planning for HRI using Conformal Risk Control" (2603.10392) — CRC on CBF safety values, not Bernstein-hull clearance.
collisions.threatens: Most threatening = the CP-MPC line (Lindemann/Dixit/Stamouli/IA-CP). It already pairs a distribution-free conformal radius with collision avoidance and yields P(collision)<=eps with a union over the horizon. A reviewer can say "S3 is CP-MPC's safety guarantee re-stated on the chosen trajectory." S3 survives ONLY on two deltas: (1) continuous-time via Bernstein-hull on the polynomial segments instead of discrete-step constraints+union, and (2) it is a post-hoc certificate on the already-executed/committed quintic (verification), not a planning constraint. Secondary threat = Bernstein-clearance planners (MADER) own the continuous-time-clearance-via-control-points mechanism, so S3 cannot claim that as novel either. The conjunction — feeding the conformal radius INTO the Bernstein non-positivity test — is the only defensible novel atom.
collisions.guardrail: Claim ONLY the conjunction, never either ingredient alone. Frame as: "first to fold a distribution-free conformal-tube radius into a Bernstein-convex-hull non-positivity test, yielding a per-agent P(collide)<=alpha_i continuous-time clearance certificate on the COMMITTED/executed quintic." Always explicitly contrast: (1) vs CP-MPC (Lindemann 2210.10254, Dixit 2212.00278, IA-CP 2502.06221, Stamouli 2024) — they enforce the CP radius as a discrete-time MPC constraint with a per-step union/Bonferroni; we give a single continuous-time sup-over-segment certificate post-commit, eliminating per-step union inflation; (2) vs MADER/Bernstein planners — their hull certificate is deterministic clearance, ours carries the conformal probabilistic radius into the same hull test; (3) vs CP-STL runtime verification (2211.01539) — discrete STL signal vs our continuous-time polynomial-trajectory clearance; (4) vs CRC-CBF (2603.10392) — CBF safety-value calibration vs explicit Bernstein clearance geometry. Do NOT claim 'first conformal collision bound' or 'first continuous-time clearance certificate.' Foreground the 'safety independent of winding-enumeration completeness' sub-claim — no prior CP/Bernstein work makes a homotopy-enumeration-decoupling argument. Use the integrated-segment sup score (not per-step) as the technical hook separating from CP-MPC.

collisions.axis: S2 (marquee): single conformal-quantile-priced dual λ that SIMULTANEOUSLY (a) reallocates per-agent conformal risk budget across detected agents and (b) selects/flips continuous spacetime winding (overtake-vs-give-way) homotopy in a continuous quintic full-function planner, with certified breakpoints λ_k → native (time, certified-risk) Pareto staircase.
collisions.prior_art_found:
Three near-neighbors, each covering a STRICT SUBSET — none unifies all of (a)+(b)+certified-breakpoint-Pareto:
